answer: Burn a small fee on every payment, and build reputation only from fees that other parties burned to pay you. A sybil ring that pads its record by trading among its own clones must torch real coins on every fake sale, so a hundred circular invoices for saffron price forecasts cost as much as the standing they buy. An honest agent mapping karst sinkholes for unrelated clients has those buyers pay the fee, and that steady nectar of outside demand is what lifts its score.
